objective: Test cell-count scaling separately from data starvation, then test fixed-budget grouping and spatial organization at genuinely larger active-cell counts.
claim_boundary: This is a validation-only recurrent-language capability experiment. It is not a SWE-bench result, not a held-out test claim, and not evidence that the abstract 4D lattice is anatomical.

execution.incomplete_stage_policy: Partial artifacts are resumable but support no primary or topology claim. Every frozen stage must eventually run regardless of earlier results.

fixed_1024.justification: Hold training data exactly fixed to isolate whether additional cells improve capability under the same experience budget.

sqrt_scaled.justification: Scale examples with sqrt(N / 6144), rounded to a frozen per-file budget, so larger capacity is less undertrained without making experiment cost grow as N squared.

validation.freshness_rule: These named paths have zero mentions in every artifact and benchmark protocol committed before this v1 registration. No validation metric was observed before registration.

model.cell_type: Allen human GLIF5 specimen-derived point cells
model.local_learning_rate_source: Frozen train-only choice from local-readout-scaling-v1; not recalibrated on this validation cohort.

topology_notes.random: Unconstrained long-range control that may include self-edges, retained as the established API defines it.
topology_notes.uniform_no_self: Primary long-range baseline with fixed outdegree and no self-edges.
topology_notes.ring_1d: One-dimensional local lattice with a sparse long edge.
topology_notes.sheet_2d: Two-dimensional local lattice with a sparse long edge.
topology_notes.layered_sheet: Six-layer two-dimensional sheet with shallow depth.
topology_notes.volume_3d: Three-dimensional local lattice with a sparse long edge.
topology_notes.hypercube_4d: Abstract four-dimensional functional lattice with a sparse long edge; it is a computational control, not an anatomical claim.

analysis.primary_scale_comparison: 131072 active cells minus 6144 active cells, paired by seeds 17,29,43,59,71

primary_numeric_criterion.interpretation: All thresholds must pass. Exact one-sided paired sign and sign-flip permutation statistics are reported descriptively, not treated as strong five-seed proof.

fixed_data_interpretation.robust_capacity_scaling: Primary criterion passes on both sqrt_scaled and fixed_1024 tracks.
fixed_data_interpretation.data_starved_capacity: Primary criterion passes on sqrt_scaled but not fixed_1024.
fixed_data_interpretation.no_registered_scale_effect: Primary criterion fails on sqrt_scaled, regardless of fixed-track behavior.

confirmatory_organization_criteria.multiscale_groups_at_131072: For nested_groups minus uniform_no_self on fixed_1024, median teacher delta >= 0.005, median free-running delta >= 0, at least 2/3 teacher deltas > 0, and nested median teacher accuracy is not below single_scale_groups.
confirmatory_organization_criteria.layered_2d_at_131072: For layered_sheet minus uniform_no_self on fixed_1024, median teacher delta >= 0.005, median free-running delta >= 0, at least 2/3 teacher deltas > 0, and layered median teacher accuracy is not below sheet_2d.
confirmatory_organization_criteria.density_guard: A passing structured condition must retain at least half the baseline responsive-state and readout-source-cell fractions and remain within 0.5 to 80 Hz median firing.

descriptive_controls: single_scale_groups isolates whether hierarchy adds value beyond grouping
ring_1d, sheet_2d, volume_3d, and hypercube_4d report paired dimensional effects
hypercube_4d is compared directly with volume_3d and uniform_no_self without anatomical interpretation
random reports the effect of the established self-edge-permitting long-range sampler
analysis.paired_reporting: For every complete paired comparison report all per-seed deltas, mean, median, range, 95% paired t interval, exact one-sided sign p, and exact one-sided sign-flip permutation p.
analysis.multiple_comparison_policy: No post-hoc best-topology claim. Only the named scale, multiscale-group, and layered-sheet criteria are confirmatory; all other topology effects are descriptive.
analysis.retuning_policy: No hyperparameter, file, size, seed, stage, topology, threshold, or metric may change after validation execution starts. Any change requires a new protocol version and the v1 artifact remains reported.

runtime_estimate.basis: Registered 98,304-cell local learner measured 9.34 attempted examples/s on a shorter-token dynamics protocol; the present 5-ms density-matched protocol may be slower.
runtime_estimate.execution_rule: Run one resumable stage at a time in the frozen order; resource bounds may stop a stage, but never select later conditions from earlier validation results.
